reviews.name: Carolyn Birdsey
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Helping Hands Auto Repair! I needed my brakes replaced, especially the rear ones, which were in pretty bad shape, and I honestly didn’t feel safe driving around with my 4-month-old baby in the car.
Scheduling was super easy, and Chris, the owner, was great to work with. He was very informative and took pictures throughout the whole process so I could actually see what was going on with my car. I appreciated how transparent he was.
I never felt pressured into doing anything, and I appreciated that Chris explained what actually needed to be done versus what was more of a personal choice.
It's hard to find an auto repair shop where you feel like you're getting honest answers and quality work, but I definitely felt that way here. I felt more comfortable and confident driving my car.
Thank you, Chris! I'll definitely be using Helping Hands Auto Repair for future work. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ethan Danforth
reviews.text: Extremely affordable and Extremely friendly! He came over to change my oil and he figured out that I was given the wrong oil filter. he went out of his way to grab a brand new one and finish the job! if you are short on cash and in need of a tune up or oil change, helping hands is the right choice!

reviews.name: Landon Wood
reviews.text:
If I could give more than 5 stars, I would without hesitation.
From the very beginning, the entire experience was professional, honest, and stress-free. The contracts were thorough but easy to understand, communication was excellent throughout the entire process, and having the invoice available online made paying quick and incredibly convenient.
He replaced the brakes and rotors on my Jeep, and unfortunately the very next day one of the wheels started smoking badly again. Instead of disappearing after the job was done like some mechanics might, he answered my call immediately, came right out, diagnosed the real issue, and found that the brake flex hose had internally collapsed, causing the caliper to seize against the rotor. Even though it wasn't something that could have reasonably been predicted during the original repair, he stayed until everything was fixed and my Jeep was safely back on the road.
That level of integrity, accountability, and customer service is incredibly rare. He genuinely cares about his customers and stands behind his work. You can tell he isn't just trying to get the job done—he wants to make sure it's done right.
Finding a mechanic you can trust is hard. Finding one who's knowledgeable, honest, responsive, and willing to go above and beyond like this is even harder. 10/10 mechanic.
Thank you again for everything!
